identity: Bannerbreak Mesa is where the orcs carry the Throng's banners to the front; hyenas, goblins and old dead fight over everything those banners leave behind.

quests.title: The Last Laugh
quests.text: My crews haul siege timbers all day. The Warpack Hyenas laugh at them from the {name:badlands}, which lie {zone_area:badlands}. Get out there in daylight and kill four. Anything with that much breath to spare can pull a rope or stop making noise.

quests.title: A Blade for Yarra
quests.text: Yarra Standardmender keeps Tornstandard Hold standing with patched banners and fighters too stubborn to fall. Report to her and say Drek sent you. I can spare a blade here; she needs every one she can get against the Accord.

quests.title: Rattle's Bad Arithmetic
quests.text: Provisioner Rattle counts our stolen wagonloads as profit at the {name:supply_camp} {dir_from_giver:supply_camp}. Kill four Siege Goblins or Siege Goblin Slingers in any combination, and kill Rattle as well. Let him work out what a dead quartermaster earns.

quests.title: Bounty: Teeth After Dark
quests.text: Night wagons need an escort through the {name:warplains}, which lie {zone_area:warplains}, and the Warpack Hyenas have volunteered to eat it. Kill six there after dark and bring yourself back for payment. You can take the bounty again twenty minutes after collecting; keeping wagon crews alive is money well spent.

quests.title: Inspect Your Bedroll
quests.text: I can train a fighter to face the Accord, but nobody fights well with a scorpion in their trousers. Hunt the War-Stinger Scorpions after dark in the {name:badlands}, which lie {zone_area:badlands}. Kill four and bring me two Venom Sacs. My fighters have earned a night's sleep without armour.

quests.title: Where the Rain Fights Back
quests.text: Rumela Stormstep holds Thunderstep Watch in Thunderroot Wilds, where even the rain sounds ready for a fight. Go and speak with her; the trolls need blades in the jungle as much as we do on the mesa. We keep each other's banners flying.

quests.title: A Scout Is Worth More
quests.text: My scouts watch for Accord patrols; the Tallgrass Tigers have learned to watch my scouts. Kill four of those tigers by day in the {name:warplains}, which lie {zone_area:warplains}. It takes years to teach a fighter when to stay quiet. I will not spend those years feeding cats.

quests.title: A Soldier's Due
quests.text: The {name:redcut_flats} lie {zone_area:redcut_flats}, and after dark the Trench Mummies still march there in armour from a war that used them up. Kill four and end their watch. Whatever banner they followed, no soldier owes it an eternity.

quests.title: Group: No Banner for Supper
quests.text: I stitch the names of our fallen into our standards, and the Goblin Banner-Eater at the {name:goblin_warcamp} {dir_from_giver:goblin_warcamp} eats them, poles and all. Gather a group and kill it; pride alone will not win that fight. Those names belong above our heads.

quests.title: Bounty: Arrows from {name:sunderstrap_camp}
quests.text: The Entrenched Bandit Archers at the {name:sunderstrap_camp} {dir_from_giver:sunderstrap_camp} keep putting arrows through supplies my fighters bled to bring here. Kill six and collect your bounty. Twenty minutes after payment you can take it again; I will keep paying as long as they keep drawing bows.

quests.title: Coin That Will Not Cool
quests.text: My Outrider's riders dropped a pay box at {name:r20_anchor_074}, {dir_from_giver:r20_anchor_074}, because the coin inside burned through their gloves. It carries an Accord requisition seal: break it and see what the Accord is paying for. The Coal-Purse Factors who carried it work the {name:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}, which lies {zone_area:front_broken_causeway/alderwood}; kill three by day, then take what you found to Drek Rampbinder at Red Ramp Post, whose crews keep digging the same boxes out of the Causeway.

quests.title: A Banner on Credit
quests.text: An Accord seal on grave coin and a toll-taker who kept our dead on the road: the Accord is buying itself a cheaper army, and I want the proof in my hand. Yarra Standardmender says the dead on The Shattered Line rally round a standard somebody keeps paying for. Kill three Brandbound Collectors at night in the {name:front_shattered_line/trenches}, which lie {zone_area:front_shattered_line/trenches}, and unpick the pledged standard at {name:r20_anchor_081}, then bring the stitching to Yarra; she reads cloth the way I read a liar.

quests.title: Orders Under Their Seal
quests.text: Pledge slips with Accord stamps, and the Accord's high war camp sits right on The Shattered Line: if they pay for those banners, its captain carries the orders. Go to the {name:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}, {dir_from_giver:pvp_camp_shattered_line_accord_high}, kill its captain and bring me the Accord Captain's Orders. Go in fast and come out faster; I need the paper more than a story about the fight.

quests.title: Spent on Nobody
quests.text: The Accord is hunting the same soot factors and burying its own burned soldiers. Worse, its orders list the seized coin by our war-chest tally marks, entered by Tallykeeper Mardra, who left last winter 'to collect what the dead were owed'; I struck her from the Warhold's roll before the whole drill yard. A bought oath is a debt with a blade on it, and ours were never for sale. Bury the branded pay we seized at {name:kragmar_thunderroot_wilds/coinpit_hollow}, {dir_of:r20_anchor_048:kragmar_thunderroot_wilds/coinpit_hollow}, unspent, before the Accord impounds it along with the truth.

quests.title: Group: The Gate Called Greyvow
quests.text: The Accord's orders end with a name: War Commander Greyvow, posted to the {name:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_high}, which lies {zone_area:pvp_camp_skyglass_canopy_accord_high}, to run their hunt for the soot factors. If anyone reaches the payers first, it will not be a commander who files our dead under evidence. Gather a group and bring him down; he fights beside that camp's garrison and is no work for one blade.

quests.title: Whispers About Fire
quests.text: Mardra sold our dead, and somebody is still buying. Vaska Ashlistener sends word that the dead of Gravesalt Escarpment whisper about fire, and the Kiln-Whisper Hexers are the ones doing the whispering. Kill three at night in the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, which lies {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/tomb_fen}, then go to Vaska at Ashveil Watch and tell her what they stopped saying.

quests.title: Group: The Collector Comes Due
quests.text: So the thing that bought our dead comes to collect them itself: Isquarre the Tithe-Eater, at {name:r20_anchor_077}. He will not have even Mardra; that debt is ours to judge, not his. Take two or three fighters you trust, break him where the ground is cracked and stay out of the crack; if the Accord turns up, it came for its own reasons. Then let Vaska Ashlistener listen to what is left.
